UnitStatement: status-writer.ts validates ISO dates with ISO_DATE_PATTERN /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, enforcing YYYY-MM-DD format.
StatusWriterInput interface: title, currentState (LifecycleState), lastUpdated, history (StatusHistoryEntry[]), optional extraFields (StatusField[]).
StatusUpdateInput interface: targetState (LifecycleState), actor, optional date and metadata (Record<string,string>).
assertIsoDate(value, field) throws Error '<field> must be YYYY-MM-DD' when value fails the ISO date pattern.
toFieldLabel(key) normalizes a metadata key to Title Case, splitting on _/-/camelCase boundaries; preserves 'SHA' as uppercase.
mergeFields(existing, metadata) merges metadata into status fields case-insensitively by label, skipping empty values and overwriting matching labels.
formatHistoryEntry renders a history line as '- <date> - State set to <state> (<actor>)' with optional ' [<notes>]' suffix; actor defaults to 'UNKNOWN'.
writeStatusDocument(input) serializes a status markdown document with title heading, Current State, Last Updated, extra fields, and a History section.
writeStatusDocument validates currentState via parseLifecycleState and lastUpdated and every history entry's date via assertIsoDate before serializing.
writeStatusDocument emits a single '-' under History when there are no history entries.
updateStatusDocument(content, input) parses an existing status doc, appends a new history entry, merges metadata fields, and returns {content, parsed}.
updateStatusDocument defaults the transition date to today's date (toISOString sliced to 10 chars) when input.date is absent.
updateStatusDocument appends history entries with source:'list' and empty raw.
transition.ts builds STATE_INDEX mapping each LifecycleState to its ordinal index in LIFECYCLE_STATES, used to detect backward transitions.
ActorRequirement type enumerates: PREPARATION, 4_DOCUMENTS, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK, WORKING_ITEMS, HUMAN.

TRANSITION_RULES define allowed lifecycle transitions: OPEN->INITIALIZED(4_DOCUMENTS), INITIALIZED->SEMANTIC_READY(CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK), INITIALIZED->IN_PROGRESS, SEMANTIC_READY->IN_PROGRESS(HUMAN,WORKING_ITEMS), IN_PROGRESS->CHECKING, CHECKING->ISSUED(HUMAN).
TransitionErrorCode union: INVALID_STATE, BACKWARD_TRANSITION, TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED, UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR, APPROVAL_SHA_REQUIRED, INVALID_APPROVAL_SHA.
LifecycleTransitionError extends Error carrying a code (TransitionErrorCode) and optional details; name is 'LifecycleTransitionError'.
LifecycleTransitionOptions interface: optional date, metadata, and approvalSha.
LifecycleTransitionResult interface: from, to (LifecycleState), actor, content.
approvalSha must match APPROVAL_SHA_PATTERN /^[0-9a-f]{7,64}$/i (git SHA-like hexadecimal token, 7-64 chars).
normalizeActor uppercases/underscores the actor and maps USER, OPERATOR, or any HUMAN-prefixed value to 'HUMAN'.
isBackwardTransition returns true when the target state's index is less than the source state's index.
isHumanGateTransition returns true for transitions targeting CHECKING or ISSUED.
parseApprovalShaForTransition requires an approvalSha for human-gate transitions (CHECKING/ISSUED), throwing APPROVAL_SHA_REQUIRED if absent and INVALID_APPROVAL_SHA if malformed.
mergeTransitionMetadata stores approvalSha under metadata.checkingApprovalSha for CHECKING and metadata.approvalSha for ISSUED.
applyLifecycleTransition validates target state, rejects backward transitions, requires an allowed transition rule, and enforces actor authorization before applying.
applyLifecycleTransition throws INVALID_STATE when parseLifecycleState fails on the target state input.
applyLifecycleTransition throws UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR when the normalized actor is not in the matched rule's actors list.
transitionStatusFile reads a status file, applies the lifecycle transition, writes the updated content back to disk (utf8), and returns the result.
ansi.ts ANSI_PATTERN /\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/ detects ANSI escape codes in a string.
ansi.ts configures a shared AnsiUp converter with use_classes=true so ANSI colors render as CSS classes.
hasAnsiEscapeCodes(value) returns whether the string contains ANSI escape codes.
renderAnsiToHtml(value) converts ANSI-coded text to HTML via the shared AnsiUp converter.
ResizablePaneKey type is the union 'fileTree' | 'toolkit' | 'chat'.
LayoutStorageState type holds widths and collapsed records keyed by ResizablePaneKey.
layout-state.ts persists layout under localStorage key 'chirality.layout.v1'.
Layout constants: COLLAPSED_PANE_WIDTH_PX=56, HANDLE_WIDTH_PX=12, MAIN_PANE_MIN_WIDTH_PX=520.
MIN_PANE_WIDTH_PX per pane: fileTree 220, toolkit 250, chat 280.
DEFAULT_PANE_WIDTH_PX per pane: fileTree 280, toolkit 300, chat 320.
clamp(value,min,max) returns min for non-finite values or when max<min, otherwise bounds value within [min,max].
createDefaultLayoutState returns default widths and all panes uncollapsed.
readLayoutStateFromStorage parses persisted layout, falling back to defaults on missing storage, missing key, non-record JSON, or parse error; pane widths clamped to [min,2000].
writeLayoutStateToStorage persists widths and collapsed state to storage, silently ignoring write failures since layout persistence is convenience-only.
resolvePaneWidth returns 0 for a hidden toolkit pane, COLLAPSED_PANE_WIDTH_PX for collapsed panes, otherwise the stored width.
countActiveHandles returns 3 when toolkit is visible, else 2.
clampPaneWidthForLayout bounds a requested pane width by the minimum and a maximum derived from layoutWidth minus other panes, handle widths, and MAIN_PANE_MIN_WIDTH_PX.
deliverable-api.ts treats PREREQUISITE and CONSTRAINT as BLOCKING_DEPENDENCY_TYPES; SATISFIED, WAIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE as NON_BLOCKING_SATISFACTION.
Execution-blocker subset is defined by dependency class 'EXECUTION' and target type 'DELIVERABLE'.
Human-gate lifecycle targets are CHECKING and ISSUED; lifecycle-transition agents are CHANGE and WORKING_ITEMS.
NEXT_LIFECYCLE_TARGETS map: OPEN->[INITIALIZED], INITIALIZED->[SEMANTIC_READY,IN_PROGRESS], SEMANTIC_READY->[IN_PROGRESS], IN_PROGRESS->[CHECKING], CHECKING->[ISSUED], ISSUED->[].
WorkspaceApiClientError extends Error carrying HTTP status, code, message, and optional details.
readJson<T> safely parses a Response body as JSON, returning undefined on failure.
requestWorkspaceApi fetches an endpoint, throws WorkspaceApiClientError on non-OK responses (using error.type/message/details) and on empty body (INVALID_RESPONSE).
DeliverableStatusSnapshot interface: projectRoot, deliverablePath, statusFilePath, status (ParsedStatusDocument).
DeliverableStatusTransitionResult extends DeliverableStatusSnapshot adding a transition {from,to,actor}.
DeliverableDependenciesSnapshot interface: projectRoot, deliverablePath, dependenciesFilePath, headers, rows (DependencyRegisterRow[]), warnings.
DependencyRowSummary interface: totalRows, activeRows, activeUpstreamBlockerCandidates, bySatisfaction (Record<string,number>).
workspaceApiErrorMessage formats WorkspaceApiClientError as '<code>: <message>', falls back to Error.message, else a generic failure string.
currentIsoDate(now=new Date()) returns the date as a YYYY-MM-DD string.
nextLifecycleTargets returns the allowed next states for a given LifecycleState, defaulting to [].
requiresApprovalShaForTarget returns true when the (uppercased) target state is a human-gate target (CHECKING/ISSUED).
canAgentTransitionLifecycle returns true when the (uppercased) agent is in LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_AGENTS (CHANGE/WORKING_ITEMS).
hasUnresolvedAssumptionGate returns true when notes mention ASSUMPTION but not RESOLVED or CLOSED.

isExecutionBlockerSubsetRow flags a dependency row as an active upstream execution blocker: class EXECUTION, status ACTIVE, direction UPSTREAM, blocking type, target type DELIVERABLE, non-satisfied, no unresolved assumption gate.
summarizeDependencyRows tallies totalRows, activeRows, activeUpstreamBlockerCandidates, and a bySatisfaction histogram (defaulting satisfaction to TBD).
fetchDeliverableStatus GETs /api/working-root/deliverable/status with projectRoot and deliverablePath query params.
transitionDeliverableStatus POSTs JSON to /api/working-root/deliverable/status/transition to apply a lifecycle transition.
fetchDeliverableDependencies GETs /api/working-root/deliverable/dependencies with projectRoot and deliverablePath query params.
requireNonEmptyPath validates a path field is non-empty and absolute, throwing WorkspaceValidationError INVALID_PROJECT_ROOT (400) otherwise; returns the resolved path.
assertWithinProjectRoot throws WorkspaceOperationError DELIVERABLE_PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT_ROOT (400) when a candidate path is not inside projectRoot.

normalizeDeliverablePath validates the deliverable path is inside projectRoot, exists as a directory, and resolves its realpath inside the canonical project root, throwing DELIVERABLE_NOT_FOUND (404) on failures.
normalizeCanonicalProjectRoot resolves the project root realpath, throwing WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE (404) if inaccessible.
getDeliverableIdFromPath extracts a DEL-NN-NN id from the directory basename, validated against DELIVERABLE_ID_PATTERN; undefined otherwise.
getErrnoCode safely extracts a NodeJS ErrnoException string 'code' from an unknown error.
readRequiredFile reads a UTF-8 file, mapping ENOENT to a caller-supplied notFound 404 error and other errors to WORKSPACE_FILE_READ_FAILED (500).
readDeliverableStatus reads and parses _STATUS.md for a deliverable, mapping StatusParseError to a WorkspaceOperationError (400).
Deliverable status file is named '_STATUS.md' inside the deliverable directory.
transitionDeliverableStatus (contracts) applies a lifecycle transition to a deliverable's _STATUS.md, mapping ENOENT, LifecycleTransitionError, and StatusParseError to WorkspaceOperationErrors.
readDeliverableDependencies reads and parses 'Dependencies.csv' in the deliverable directory, returning headers, rows, and warnings.
Deliverable dependency register file is named 'Dependencies.csv' inside the deliverable directory.

writeDeliverableDependencies serializes dependency rows (with hostDeliverableId and previousRows context) to Dependencies.csv, re-reads it, and returns the merged warnings; maps DependencyContractError to a 400.
file-tree-refresh.ts constants: FILE_TREE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15000, FILE_TREE_REFRESH_DEBOUNCE_MS=350.
createRefreshScheduler returns a debounced scheduler with schedule()/cancel(); schedule cancels any pending timer and fires onRefresh then optional onAfterRefresh after debounceMs.
shouldRefreshForVisibilityState returns true only when the visibility state is 'visible'.
shouldPollWhenHidden returns true when the document is not hidden.
filesystem.ts limits: MAX_TREE_ENTRIES_PER_DIRECTORY=60, MAX_SCOPE_SCAN_DIRECTORIES=2500.
Directory scans skip .git, .next, node_modules, dist, dist-electron, and out directories.
WorkspaceValidationError extends Error with status and code fields.
WorkspaceOperationError extends Error with status, code, and optional details.
TreeNode type: name, path, kind ('directory'|'file'|'symlink'), optional children and truncated flag.
KNOWLEDGE_MARKER_PATTERNS detect knowledge decomposition via phrases like 'knowledge categories', 'knowledge types', 'domain decomp', or 'domain decomposition'.
KNOWLEDGE_TYPE_BUCKETS map deliverable files to knowledge types (Datasheet, Specification, Guidance, Procedure, Dependencies, References, Context, Status, Semantic, Memory) by filename presence.
compareDirectoryEntries sorts directories before files, then alphabetically by name.
ensureAbsolutePath requires a non-empty absolute projectRoot, throwing WorkspaceValidationError INVALID_PROJECT_ROOT (400) otherwise.
normalizeProjectRoot validates projectRoot is an accessible directory, throwing WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE (404) otherwise.
buildTree recursively builds a directory tree bounded by remaining depth, marking nodes truncated on read errors or when entries exceed MAX_TREE_ENTRIES_PER_DIRECTORY; symlinks are leaf nodes.
readProjectRootTree clamps depth to [1,6] (default 3) before building the tree.
splitStableId splits a folder name at the first underscore into {id,label}, replacing underscores in the label with spaces.
isDeliverableDirectory matches folder names like DEL-NN-NN (2-3 digit package, optional suffix).
isKnowledgeTypeDirectory matches folder names like KTY-XX-XX with alphanumeric segments.
buildDeliverableCompositeKey composes a key as '<pkg>::<deliverableId>'.
getPackageFolderForDeliverable finds the PKG-NN segment in the deliverable's relative path, defaulting to 'UNKNOWN_PACKAGE'.
parseDeliverableStatus reads _STATUS.md and returns the lowercased current lifecycle state, or 'unknown' on failure.

scanProjectScopes walks the project tree (depth<=8, bounded by MAX_SCOPE_SCAN_DIRECTORIES) collecting deliverable and knowledge-type directories that contain _STATUS.md, plus a knowledge-decomposition flag.
scanProjectDeliverables walks the project for deliverable directories, resolving each one's package, lifecycle status, and knowledge-type buckets, sorted by package then id.
workspaceErrorPayload maps WorkspaceValidationError and WorkspaceOperationError to {status, body:{error:{type,message,details}}}, defaulting unknown errors to 500 WORKSPACE_FAILURE.
NavigationIntentScheduler type exposes schedule(target) and cancel().
createNavigationIntentScheduler coalesces navigation targets via queueMicrotask, navigating to the latest non-empty trimmed target unless cancelled (tracked by a generation counter).
TaskScopeMode type is 'DELIVERABLES' | 'KNOWLEDGE_TYPES'.
TaskSelectionSnapshot type: scopeMode (TaskScopeMode), scopeKey, targetDeliverableKey.
normalizeTaskScopeMode returns 'KNOWLEDGE_TYPES' only when requested and knowledge decomposition is enabled, otherwise 'DELIVERABLES'.
sanitizeTaskSelection validates a task selection, falling back to DELIVERABLES when knowledge decomposition is disabled and clearing keys not present in the available deliverable/knowledge-type sets.
DirectorySelectionResult type: cancelled (boolean), optional path and error.
ChiralityBridge type: optional platform, versions {chrome,electron,node}, and selectDirectory() returning Promise<DirectorySelectionResult>.
chirality-window.d.ts augments the global Window interface with an optional 'chirality' ChiralityBridge property.
tsconfig.electron.json targets ES2022/commonjs with node moduleResolution, rootDir 'electron', outDir 'dist-electron', strict, sourceMap, and node types.
tsconfig.electron.json includes only 'electron/**/*.ts'.
tsconfig.json targets ES2022 with dom/dom.iterable/es2022 libs, strict, noEmit, esnext module, bundler moduleResolution, jsx preserve, isolatedModules, incremental, and the next plugin.
tsconfig.json includes next-env.d.ts, all .ts/.tsx, and .next types; excludes node_modules and dist-electron.
Import statements pulling LifecycleState and status-parser helpers into status-writer.ts.
